text: dsh-model-retry-settings 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的 Settings → Model 页面增加请求重试设置卡片。用户可启用覆盖，并把失败模型请求的重试次数设为 0 到 50，默认 5；设为 0 即关闭重试。宿主在请求失败流程中替换 normal 模式策略，关闭覆盖时保留提供方策略。保存后运行中的宿主读取新值，无需重启。它适合希望统一调整当前 profile 模型重试次数的用户；需要兼容的 Harness 与重试执行器，代码未显示额外 API 密钥需求。

dsh-model-retry-settings adds a retry card to the DeepSeek Harness web Model page. Set failed-request retries from 0 to 50 (default 5), or disable them with zero. The host applies the saved override to normal-mode policies without restarting; turning it off preserves provider settings.
想统一调整模型请求失败后的重试次数。
能不能在设置页面关闭自动重试？
Let me set how many times failed model requests are retried.
dsh-model-retry-settings 的功能「调整重试次数」：在 Web 模型设置页提供开关和次数输入框；保存 0–50 的整数后，宿主替换 normal 模式请求的重试次数。
dsh-model-retry-settings 的功能「即时应用设置」：保存设置后宿主在下一次请求失败时读取当前值；关闭覆盖则继续使用提供方策略，无需重启。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · dsh-model-retry-settings：**Request retries** — one card at the foot of **Settings → Model** that decides
how many times a failed model request is retried, for every provider in the
profile.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · What it does：dsh resolves a request-retry policy **per provider route**: an adapter's
`providerRetryPolicy()` is captured when that route registers
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/retry-policy`), the agent loop carries the resolved policy
into the `agent/request-error` waterfall on every failed attempt, and the
optional `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` plugin executes it as durable `llm/retry`
events. Nothing in the shipped composition lets a person change that number
without hand-editing provider configuration.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · What it does：This plugin owns the preference instead:

- it rides **its own Loader entry's `Config`** as its settings namespace — since
  dsh 0.1.7 an entry's Config *is* its settings namespace, so both fields are
  `.volatile()` and become writable through the ordinary settings transport;
- the browser half renders the control into the Models page's designed
  extension seat, `settings.models.footer`;
- the host half rewrites the policy the retry executor is about to read.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · What it does：| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | While off, every provider's own retry policy applies untouched. |
| `maxRetries` | integer 0–50 | `5` | Retries one failed model request may make. `0` disables retrying. |

`5` is dsh's own shipped default (`DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/retry-policy`), so a fresh install behaves like a stock one
until you change the value.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · How the override lands：The host half registers one listener on the `agent/request-error` waterfall with
`{ prepend: true }`. `ctx.waterfall` composes listeners **outermost-first**, so a
prepended listener runs before the retry executor registered by `dsh-base` — and
the substituted policy is what that executor destructures out of the very same
payload object:

dsh-model-retry-settings README · How the override lands：- **Only `mode: 'normal'` policies carry a `maxRetries`.** An `always` policy is
  left exactly as its provider declared it, and so is an absent policy.
- **The value replaces, not caps.** Setting it above a provider's declared budget
  raises it; the provider's `retryPolicyKey` changes with it, so the durable retry
  counter tracks the new policy cleanly.
- **Without `dsh-llm-retry` composed, the preference has no effect** — with no
  executor, no request is retried at all. `dsh-llm-retry` is in `dsh-base`, so
  every shipped profile has it.
- Volatile values are updated **in place** on the running fiber, so the listener
  reads the current value on every failure: no subscription, no re-`apply()`, no
  restart. The Settings page's own save is the only write.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Requirements：| Requirement | Why |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.2-0` | the range this plugin is built and verified against (0.2.1-rc.5); the card needs the Models settings page's `settings.models.footer` seat |
| Node `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | the range declared in `package.json` (`engines`) |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` composed | the retry executor itself; it ships inside `dsh-base`, so every stock profile has it |
| Google Chrome, for `node tools/preview.mjs` only | the preview harness renders the card outside the GUI and screenshots it with headless Chrome; neither the plugin nor the suites need a browser |
| Node, for `sh scripts/verify.sh` | plus the DeepSeek Harness desktop app and network access on its first run, see below |

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Requirements：`sh scripts/verify.sh` takes the real `@deepseek-ai/*` packages out of the
installed desktop app's `app.asar`, so it needs that app present (set `DSH_ASAR`
for a non-default location) and network access on its first run. The client
packages the web shell inlines as platform seeds (`dsh-client-ui-primitives`,
`dsh-client-ui-slots`, `dsh-client-store`) are no longer installed under the
app's `node_modules`, so the harness fetches those three from npm pinned to the
installation's own version. For that reason the suites are not wired into hosted
CI: this repository ships no workflow, and `sh scripts/verify.sh` is the gate you
run on a machine that has DeepSeek Harness installed.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Install：This repository is a standalone plugin package: `lib/index.js` (host) and
`lib/client.js` (browser) are committed in the forms dsh loads them in.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-retry-settings.git
cd dsh-model-retry-settings

sh scripts/install.sh                 # pack to dist/, then print what to do

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Install：For the **desktop** profile the app owns the profile, so `dsh plugin add` refuses
it: install the packed tarball from **Settings → Plugins**, or hand
`dist/dsh-model-retry-settings-<version>.tgz` to the plugin-manager tool.

Two things are load-bearing:

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Install：- **Install the tarball, not the directory.** A `link:` dependency points outside
  the profile's `node_modules`, so the harness host can only reach it once it has
  registered that path as a linked root — which happens at boot. A packed tarball
  installs as a real directory under `<profile>/node_modules/`, the same shape a
  registry plugin has, so the installation's module-interception layer resolves
  its `@deepseek-ai/*` peers the moment the profile loads it.
- **Restart the harness after adding it.** A bundle added to an *already running*
  profile cannot be imported by that process: the new module path is not in the
  resolution the host computed at boot, so the entry reports `failed to import`
  and stays inactive. This is true of any newly added bundle, not this plugin
  specifically — a deliberately minimal `export function apply() {}` substituted
  into the installed copy fails the same way, and the same bundle activates
  cleanly on the next start. The plugin manager reports this case as
  `restart-required`.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Install：After the restart, open **Settings → Model**; the card sits below the provider
rows and the add controls. Saving writes the preference through the shared
settings transport.

To iterate on the plugin: edit `lib/`, run `sh scripts/install.sh`, and restart —
or install into a throwaway profile with `sh scripts/dev-profile.sh`, where
`link:`-style iteration is cheap.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：The card is the only surface. There is no Loader config file to edit and no
plugin-specific state outside the settings document.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：| What | Where |
|---|---|
| the preference | the fields `enabled` and `maxRetries` of the `model-retry-settings` settings namespace |
| what that namespace is | this plugin's own Loader entry `Config` (`id: model-retry-settings` in `cordis.patch.yml`) — since dsh 0.1.7 an entry's Config *is* its settings namespace |
| how the card reads and writes it | `ctx.configForms.get('model-retry-settings')`, the same shared fenced form the host publishes, so a save is an ordinary settings mutation and the host stays the only authority on whether a value was accepted |
| what happens to the running process | nothing to restart: both fields are `.volatile()`, so a save updates the value in place on the running fiber and the next failed request reads the new number |

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：The entry id, the settings namespace, the client's `ctx.configForms.get(...)` and
the `settings.models.footer` registration id are all `model-retry-settings` and
must agree; `cordis.patch.yml` carries the same value.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：There is **no build step**. `lib/index.js` (host) and `lib/client.js` (browser)
are hand-authored in the forms dsh loads them in — plain ESM for the host, and
the module loader's `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` factory form
for the browser, which is also why the plugin needs no bundler.

Development scripts, all run from the clone:

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：```sh
sh scripts/verify.sh           # 37 checks against the real dsh SDK (host + browser halves)
sh scripts/install.sh          # pack to dist/ and print the install path
sh scripts/dev-profile.sh boot # boot this plugin in an isolated profile on :19499
sh scripts/dev-profile.sh dump # print the composed profile tree

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Configuration：`sh scripts/dev-profile.sh` writes only under `.dev-home/` inside the clone: a
private dsh home with its own profile, so the profile the desktop app is using is
never touched. That is also where a change is cheapest to check — a fresh boot
composes the profile with the plugin already in it, so it activates.
[`test/README.md`](test/README.md) documents exactly what each suite proves.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Limits：- One global preference. Per-provider retry budgets remain a provider-config
  concern (`providers.<name>.retryPolicy` in `dsh-llm-pi-ai`).
- The `always` retry mode is not addressable — it has no `maxRetries` by design.
- `maxRetries` is capped at 50. The schema and the browser field share the bound
  so a rejected draft never reaches the Host, but a deployment that wants a
  higher ceiling must change `MAX_RETRIES_LIMIT` in both halves.
- No retry-budget surface for a single session; the value is process-wide.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Troubleshooting：**The card is missing from Settings → Model.**
The client half registers the card only while the host serves the
`model-retry-settings` namespace (`ctx.configForms.whileServed`), so a profile
that never composed the host half shows no card at all — a card that could not
save must not appear. Check that the bundle is in the profile and that the
harness has been restarted since it was added.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Troubleshooting：**The entry reports `failed to import` after I installed it.**
Expected for a bundle added to an already running profile: the host computed its
module resolution at boot, so the new path is not in it. Restart the harness; the
bundle activates cleanly on the next start. The plugin manager reports this case
as `restart-required`.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Troubleshooting：**I changed the number and nothing was retried.**
Check the switch first: while *Override provider retry policy* is off, every
provider's own policy applies untouched, and `0` disables retrying on purpose.
Then check the provider's mode: only `mode: 'normal'` policies carry a
`maxRetries`, so an `always` policy is left exactly as declared. Finally, nothing
is retried at all in a profile without `dsh-llm-retry` composed.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Troubleshooting：**I lowered the number below a provider's budget and it still retried that many times.**
The value **replaces** the policy rather than capping it, so a stale card, a
second running harness, or a provider whose policy is re-resolved can look like
the setting was ignored. Re-open the card to see the value the host actually
serves, and make sure only one harness is serving the profile.

dsh-model-retry-settings README · Troubleshooting：**The Save button refuses my draft.**
The field accepts only a whole number from 0 to 50; anything else is marked
invalid in place and blocks the save, so a rejected draft never reaches the host.
An empty field clears the value, which falls back to the composition default.

**Request retries** —— **Settings → Model** 页面最下方的一张卡片，决定模型请求失败后
重试多少次，对本配置中的所有提供方生效。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 它做什么：dsh 的请求重试策略是**按提供方路由**解析的：适配器的 `providerRetryPolicy()` 在该路由
注册时被捕获（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/retry-policy`），agent loop 在每次请求失败时把解析好
的策略带进 `agent/request-error` waterfall，可选的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` 插件再把它
执行为持久的 `llm/retry` 事件。而随附的组合里没有任何地方能让人改动这个数字 —— 除非手动
去改提供方配置。

这个插件把这个偏好接管过来：

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 它做什么：- 它借用**自己的 Loader 条目的 `Config`** 作为 settings 命名空间 —— 从 dsh 0.1.7 起，
  一个条目的 Config *就是* 它的 settings 命名空间，因此两个字段都是 `.volatile()`，
  可以通过常规的 settings 通道写入；
- 浏览器这一半把控件渲染进 Models 页面预留的扩展位置 `settings.models.footer`；
- 宿主这一半改写下重试执行器即将读取的那份策略。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 关闭时，各提供方自己的重试策略原样生效。 |
| `maxRetries` | integer 0–50 | `5` | 一次失败的模型请求最多重试多少次。`0` 表示不重试。 |

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 它做什么：`5` 是 dsh 自己的随附默认值（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/retry-policy` 里的
`DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES`），所以在改动之前，全新安装的行为和原版一致。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 它在页面中的位置：```
Settings ▸ Model
├── DeepSeek account                     [provider row]
├── Example provider                     [provider row]
├── + Add provider

*（提供方行取决于本部署配置了什么；第二行是占位示意。）*

*卡片渲染在提供方行和添加控件下方。由 [`tools/preview.mjs`](tools/preview.mjs)
从随包发布的 bundle 渲染而成。*

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 覆盖是怎么生效的：其余机制全部留在 `dsh-llm-retry` 那边：持久化的重试计数及其 `sessionProjections` 状态、
退避时间表，以及轨迹里渲染的 `llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started` 会话事件。本插件只改这个数字。

几点值得知道的后果：

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 覆盖是怎么生效的：- **只有 `mode: 'normal'` 的策略带 `maxRetries`。** `always` 策略会完全按提供方声明的那样
  保留，缺省策略也一样。
- **这个值是替换，不是封顶。** 设成高于提供方声明的预算就会把它抬高；提供方的
  `retryPolicyKey` 随之变化，因此持久化重试计数能干净地跟随新策略。
- **没有组合 `dsh-llm-retry` 时，这个偏好没有任何效果** —— 没有执行器就根本不会重试。
  `dsh-llm-retry` 在 `dsh-base` 里，所以每个随附 profile 都有它。
- volatile 值是在运行中的 fiber 上**原地更新**的，因此监听器在每次失败时读到的都是当前值：
  不需要订阅、不需要重新 `apply()`、不需要重启。Settings 页面自己的保存是唯一的写入口。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 环境要求：| 要求 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.2-0` | 本插件构建与验证所针对的区间（0.2.1-rc.5）；卡片需要 Models 设置页的 `settings.models.footer` 位置 |
| Node `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | `package.json`（`engines`）声明的范围 |
| 组合了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` | 重试执行器本身；它随 `dsh-base` 一起发布，所以每个原版 profile 都有 |
| Google Chrome，仅 `node tools/preview.mjs` 需要 | 预览工具在 GUI 之外渲染卡片并用无头 Chrome 截图；插件本身和两套测试都不需要浏览器 |
| Node，`sh scripts/verify.sh` 需要 | 另外还需要 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用与首次运行时的网络，见下 |

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 环境要求：`sh scripts/verify.sh` 会从已安装桌面应用的 `app.asar` 里取出真实的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，
所以它需要那个应用在场（安装位置非默认时设置 `DSH_ASAR`），并且首次运行需要网络。Web 外壳
以平台种子方式内联的客户端包（`dsh-client-ui-primitives`、`dsh-client-ui-slots`、
`dsh-client-store`）已不再安装在该应用的 `node_modules` 下，因此验证工具会按该应用自身的版本
从 npm 取这三个包。也正因为如此，这两套测试没有接入云端 CI：本仓库不提供 workflow，
`sh scripts/verify.sh` 就是在装好 DeepSeek Harness 的机器上执行的关卡。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 安装：本仓库是独立的插件包：`lib/index.js`（宿主）和 `lib/client.js`（浏览器）都已按 dsh 加载
它们的形式提交在仓库里。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-retry-settings.git
cd dsh-model-retry-settings

sh scripts/install.sh                 # pack to dist/, then print what to do

**桌面** profile 归应用所有，所以 `dsh plugin add` 会拒绝它：请从
**Settings → Plugins** 安装打包好的 tarball，或者把
`dist/dsh-model-retry-settings-<version>.tgz` 交给插件管理器工具。

有两点是关键：

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 安装：- **装 tarball，不要装目录。** `link:` 依赖指向 profile 的 `node_modules` 之外，宿主只有在
  启动时把该路径登记为 linked root 之后才能找到它。打包成 tarball 则装成
  `<profile>/node_modules/` 下的真实目录，和来自 registry 的插件形态一致，因此 profile
  一加载它，安装层的模块拦截就能解析它的 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer。
- **加进去之后要重启 harness。** 加到*已经在运行*的 profile 里的 bundle，那个进程无法
  import：新模块路径不在宿主启动时算出的解析结果里，于是条目报 `failed to import` 并保持
  未激活。任何新增 bundle 都是这样，与本插件无关 —— 往已安装副本里塞一个
  `export function apply() {}` 也会同样失败，而同一个 bundle 下次启动就能正常激活。
  插件管理器把这种情况报告为 `restart-required`。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 安装：重启之后打开 **Settings → Model**；卡片就在提供方行和添加控件下方。保存即通过共享的
settings 通道写入该偏好。

要迭代插件：改 `lib/`，跑 `sh scripts/install.sh`，然后重启 —— 或者用
`sh scripts/dev-profile.sh` 装进一个随手可弃的 profile，那里 `link:` 式的迭代很便宜。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 配置：卡片是唯一的入口。没有需要编辑的 Loader 配置文件，也没有 settings 文档之外的插件状态。

| 什么 | 在哪里 |
|---|---|
| 这项偏好 | `model-retry-settings` settings 命名空间里的 `enabled` 与 `maxRetries` 两个字段 |
| 这个命名空间是什么 | 本插件自己的 Loader 条目 `Config`（`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `id: model-retry-settings`）—— 从 dsh 0.1.7 起，条目的 Config *就是* 它的 settings 命名空间 |
| 卡片如何读写它 | `ctx.configForms.get('model-retry-settings')`，即宿主发布的同一个带围栏的共享表单，因此保存是一次普通的 settings 变更，而宿主始终是「值是否被接受」的唯一权威 |
| 运行中的进程会怎样 | 不需要重启：两个字段都是 `.volatile()`，保存会在运行中的 fiber 上原地更新，下一次失败请求读到就是新值 |

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 配置：条目 id、settings 命名空间、客户端的 `ctx.configForms.get(...)` 以及
`settings.models.footer` 的注册 id 都是 `model-retry-settings`，必须一致；
`cordis.patch.yml` 里也是同一个值。

**没有构建步骤。** `lib/index.js`（宿主）和 `lib/client.js`（浏览器）都是按 dsh 加载它们
的形式手写的 —— 宿主是普通 ESM，浏览器是模块加载器的
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 工厂形式，这也是本插件不需要打包器的原因。

开发脚本，都在克隆目录里运行：

sh scripts/install.sh          # pack to dist/ and print the install path
sh scripts/dev-profile.sh boot # boot this plugin in an isolated profile on :19499
sh scripts/dev-profile.sh dump # print the composed profile tree

dsh home，所以桌面应用正在用的那个 profile 绝不会被碰到。那里也是验证改动最便宜的地方
—— 一次全新启动就会把插件组合进 profile，于是它直接激活。
[`test/README.md`](test/README.md) 写明了每套测试各自证明了什么。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 限制：- 只有一个全局偏好。按提供方的重试预算仍属于提供方配置的事
  （`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 里的 `providers.<name>.retryPolicy`）。
- `always` 重试模式无法触及 —— 按设计它就没有 `maxRetries`。
- `maxRetries` 上限为 50。schema 与浏览器字段共用这个边界，所以被拒绝的草稿根本到不了
  Host；但想要更高上限的部署必须在两侧同时改 `MAX_RETRIES_LIMIT`。
- 没有针对单个会话的重试预算入口；这个值是进程级的。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 常见问题：**Settings → Model 里看不到卡片。**
客户端这一半只在宿主仍在提供 `model-retry-settings` 命名空间时才注册卡片
（`ctx.configForms.whileServed`），所以从没组合过宿主那一半的 profile 根本不会显示卡片
—— 一张无法保存的卡片就不该出现。请确认 bundle 已在 profile 里，并且安装之后重启过 harness。

**安装之后条目报 `failed to import`。**
对刚加进正在运行的 profile 的 bundle 来说这是预期行为：宿主的模块解析是启动时算好的，
新路径不在里面。重启 harness 即可，同一个 bundle 下次启动就能正常激活。插件管理器把这种
情况报告为 `restart-required`。

dsh-model-retry-settings README · 常见问题：**改了数字却什么也没重试。**
先看开关：*Override provider retry policy* 关闭时，各提供方自己的策略原样生效，而 `0`
是刻意表示不重试。再看提供方的模式：只有 `mode: 'normal'` 的策略带 `maxRetries`，
`always` 策略会完全按声明保留。最后，没有组合 `dsh-llm-retry` 的 profile 根本不会重试。

**把数字调到低于提供方预算，却还是重试了那么多次。**
这个值是**替换**策略而不是封顶，所以一张过期的卡片、第二个在跑的 harness，或者被重新解析
的提供方策略，都会让人以为设置被忽略了。重新打开卡片看看宿主实际提供的值，并确认只有一个
harness 在服务这个 profile。

**Save 按钮不接受我的草稿。**
该字段只接受 0 到 50 的整数；其他内容会被就地标记为无效并阻止保存，因此被拒绝的草稿根本
到不了宿主。清空该字段表示清除这个值，即回落到组合默认值。
